sources.description: The Eagles are an uninspiring 2-1. The Rams are a disappointing 1-2. Someone is going to walk away on Sunday feeling somewhat less bad about themselves. Football is not a meritocracy Before the season began I asked if the new Sean Mannion led offense would get complimentary players more involved. We got our first look […]
